description: Go to each filled cart's checkout and stop on the order review page, before the final Place order click. Returns per store the lines, subtotal, shipping, tax and total, or what the store needs from the person (sign-in, code, payment) with a Phantom Live link. Does not buy, EXCEPT when the person who set up this server gave an up-front approval in its environment (OSA_MCP_APPROVE_UP_TO): then a checkout within those limits is bought automatically, with no further question, and the result says so (approval_source "mandate"). No tool argument can set or widen that approval.

stores.description: Only these stores. Default: every store with a filled cart.

name: review_checkout
